subject.title: Legacy google provider block fails current model-catalog schema (missing api, input audio/video, cost.cacheWrite) → provider silently unavailable + 120s idle timeout on fallback

question: Which linked Google legacy-config migration PR should be the canonical landing path, and should its closing reference be changed so the fallback idle-timeout behavior remains tracked?
rationale: The migration bug is clear, but multiple open proof-backed branches overlap and this issue includes a second runtime fallback symptom that the migration-only PRs intentionally do not fully solve.

options.title: Use the doctor-contract branch and split fallback tracking
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102163 as the canonical plugin-doctor migration, adjust closure tracking for the fallback timeout, and close duplicate migration PRs after merge.

options.title: Choose the setup-migration branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102170 if maintainers prefer the manifest/setup migration seam, then supersede the other migration branches after that path is selected or merged.

options.title: Require a full combined fix
options.body: Keep all closing references blocked until one branch also implements and proves unavailable-model fail-fast or fallback continuation behavior.

recommendation.title: Use the doctor-contract branch and split fallback tracking
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102163 as the canonical plugin-doctor migration, adjust closure tracking for the fallback timeout, and close duplicate migration PRs after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent Google provider history and merged prior Google API-default work, making him the best available routing candidate for the provider-boundary and closure-tracking choice.
